description: H₂O bond-angle knot-hierarchy correction probe (Reeb-rotation framework). Computes the figure-eight Reeb rotation θ_4₁ on V_(2,1) (=117°, lepton-mixing) and the growth/rotation split of the leading bond (σ) and lone (e⁻) operators. Honest finding: the residual ≈2.7° is NOT the next knot's raw rotation; it is the bond↔lone Reeb-phase difference at the alternating-knot level (H₄⁺ compute, blocked by the missing Rust kernel). No fitting. Owner's knot-hierarchy direction.

data.finding: θ_4₁ = 117.09° (figure-eight Reeb rotation, lepton-mixing) is NOT the 2.69° bond-angle residual and no clean ratio yields it without fitting. The bond σ is growth (|λ|≠1, no phase); the rotation channel opens only for alternating sub-braids, so the angular correction is the bond↔lone Reeb-PHASE DIFFERENCE at the 4₁ level (mirrors Δtr=hz² for the sign). That difference needs the bond/lone braids dressed with the figure-eight block — an H₄⁺ seminormal compute, partly blocked by the missing Rust kernel. Concrete next step (non-abelian Stokes holonomy difference), not a fit.
